1:0WOR_RES0 (00)R/WControls the Event 0 resolution as well as maximum timeout of the WOR module and maximum timeout under normal RX operation:
SettingResolution (1 LSB)Max timeout
0 (00)1 period (28 – 29 \mus)1.8 – 1.9 seconds
